verses.original: Ἡ φιλαδελφία μενέτω
verses.transliteration: Hē philadelphia menetō
verses.literal: Continue in brotherly love
verses.literalPt: PERMANEÇA o amor fraternal.

verses.original: τῆς φιλοξενίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε διὰ ταύτης γὰρ ἔλαθόν τινες ξενίσαντες ἀγγέλους
verses.transliteration: tēs philoxenias mē epilanthanesthe dia tautēs gar elathon tines xenisantes angelous
verses.literal: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers for by so doing . . . some people have entertained angels without knowing it
verses.literalPt: Não vos esqueçais da hospitalidade, porque por ela alguns, não o sabendo, hospedaram anjos.

verses.original: μιμνῄσκεσθε τῶν δεσμίων ὡς συνδεδεμένοι τῶν κακουχουμένων ὡς καὶ αὐτοὶ ὄντες ἐν σώματι
verses.transliteration: mimnēskesthe tōn desmiōn hōs syndedemenoi tōn kakouchoumenōn hōs kai autoi ontes en sōmati
verses.literal: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos dos presos, como se estivésseis presos com eles, e dos maltratados, como sendo-o vós mesmos também no corpo.

verses.original: Τίμιος ὁ γάμος ἐν πᾶσιν καὶ ἡ κοίτη ἀμίαντος πόρνους γὰρ καὶ μοιχοὺς κρινεῖ ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Timios ho gamos en pasin kai hē koitē amiantos pornous gar kai moichous krinei ho Theos
verses.literal: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers
verses.literalPt: Venerado seja entre todos o matrimônio e o leito sem mácula; porém, aos que se dão à prostituição, e aos adúlteros, Deus os julgará.

verses.original: Ἀφιλάργυρος ὁ τρόπος ἀρκούμενοι τοῖς παροῦσιν αὐτὸς γὰρ εἴρηκεν Οὐ μή σε ἀνῶ οὐδ’ οὐ μή σε ἐγκαταλίπω
verses.transliteration: Aphilargyros ho tropos arkoumenoi tois parousin autos gar eirēken Ou mē se anō oud’ ou mē se enkatalipō
verses.literal: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have for God has said Never will I leave you never will I forsake you
verses.literalPt: Sejam vossos costumes sem avareza, contentando-vos com o que tendes; porque ele disse: Não te deixarei, nem te desampararei.

verses.original: Ὥστε θαρροῦντας ἡμᾶς λέγειν Κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός καὶ οὐ φοβηθήσομαι τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος
verses.transliteration: Hōste tharrountas hēmas legein Kyrios emoi boēthos kai ou phobēthēsomai ti poiēsei moi anthrōpos
verses.literal: So we say with confidence The Lord is my helper I will not be afraid What can man do to me
verses.literalPt: E assim com confiança ousemos dizer: O SENHOR é o meu ajudador, e não temerei O que me possa fazer o homem.

verses.original: Μνημονεύετε τῶν ἡγουμένων ὑμῶν οἵτινες ἐλάλησαν ὑμῖν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ ὧν ἀναθεωροῦντες τὴν ἔκβασιν τῆς ἀναστροφῆς μιμεῖσθε τὴν πίστιν
verses.transliteration: Mnēmoneuete tōn hēgoumenōn hymōn hoitines elalēsan hymin ton logon tou Theou hōn anatheōrountes tēn ekbasin tēs anastrophēs mimeisthe tēn pistin
verses.literal: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos dos vossos pastores, que vos falaram a palavra de Deus, a fé dos quais imitai, atentando para a sua maneira de viver.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐχθὲς καὶ σήμερον ὁ αὐτός καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας
verses.transliteration: Iēsous Christos echthes kai sēmeron ho autos kai eis tous aiōnas
verses.literal: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever
verses.literalPt: Jesus Cristo é o mesmo, ontem, e hoje, e eternamente.

verses.original: Διδαχαῖς ποικίλαις καὶ ξέναις μὴ παραφέρεσθε καλὸν γὰρ χάριτι βεβαιοῦσθαι τὴν καρδίαν οὐ βρώμασιν ἐν οἷς οὐκ ὠφελήθησαν οἱ περιπατοῦντες
verses.transliteration: Didachais poikilais kai xenais mē parapheresthe kalon gar chariti bebaiousthai tēn kardian ou brōmasin en hois ouk ōphelēthēsan hoi peripatountes
verses.literal: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them
verses.literalPt: Não vos deixeis levar em redor por doutrinas várias e estranhas, porque bom é que o coração se fortifique com graça, e não com alimentos que de nada aproveitaram aos que a eles se entregaram.

verses.original: Ἔχομεν θυσιαστήριον ἐξ οὗ φαγεῖν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἐξουσίαν οἱ τῇ σκηνῇ λατρεύοντες
verses.transliteration: Echomen thysiastērion ex hou phagein ouk echousin exousian hoi tē skēnē latreuontes
verses.literal: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat
verses.literalPt: Temos um altar, de que não têm direito de comer os que servem ao tabernáculo.

verses.original: Ὧν γὰρ εἰσφέρεται ζῴων τὸ αἷμα περὶ ἁμαρτίας εἰς τὰ ἅγια διὰ τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τούτων τὰ σώματα κατακαίεται ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς
verses.transliteration: Hōn gar eispheretai zōōn to haima peri hamartias eis ta hagia dia tou archiereōs toutōn ta sōmata katakaietai exō tēs parembolēs
verses.literal: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin the bodies are burned outside the camp
verses.literalPt: Porque os corpos dos animais, cujo sangue é, pelo pecado, trazido pelo sumo sacerdote para o santuário, são queimados fora do arraial.

verses.original: διὸ καὶ Ἰησοῦς ἵνα ἁγιάσῃ διὰ τοῦ ἰδίου αἵματος τὸν λαόν ἔξω τῆς πύλης ἔπαθεν
verses.transliteration: dio kai Iēsous hina hagiasē dia tou idiou haimatos ton laon exō tēs pylēs epathen
verses.literal: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to sanctify the people by His own blood
verses.literalPt: E por isso também Jesus, para santificar o povo pelo seu próprio sangue, padeceu fora da porta.

verses.original: τοίνυν ἐξερχώμεθα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτοῦ φέροντες
verses.transliteration: toinyn exerchōmetha pros auton exō tēs parembolēs ton oneidismon autou pherontes
verses.literal: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp bearing the disgrace He bore
verses.literalPt: Saiamos, pois, a ele fora do arraial, levando o seu vitupério.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ὧδε μένουσαν πόλιν ἀλλὰ τὴν μέλλουσαν ἐπιζητοῦμεν
verses.transliteration: ou gar echomen hōde menousan polin alla tēn mellousan epizētoumen
verses.literal: For here we do not have a permanent city but we are looking for the city that is to come
verses.literalPt: Porque não temos aqui cidade permanente, mas buscamos a futura.

verses.original: Δι’ αὐτοῦ οὖν ἀναφέρωμεν θυσίαν αἰνέσεως διὰ παντὸς τῷ Θεῷ τοῦτ’ ἔστιν καρπὸν χειλέων ὁμολογούντων τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Di’ autou oun anapherōmen thysian aineseōs dia pantos tō Theō tout’ estin karpon cheileōn homologountōn tō onomati autou
verses.literal: Through Jesus therefore let us continually offer . . . . . . to God a sacrifice of praise - the fruit of lips that confess His name
verses.literalPt: Portanto, ofereçamos sempre por ele a Deus sacrifício de louvor, isto é, o fruto dos lábios que confessam o seu nome.

verses.original: τῆς δὲ εὐποιΐας καὶ κοινωνίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε τοιαύταις γὰρ θυσίαις εὐαρεστεῖται ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: tēs de eupoiias kai koinōnias mē epilanthanesthe toiautais gar thysiais euaresteitai ho Theos
verses.literal: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others for with such sacrifices God is pleased
verses.literalPt: E não vos esqueçais da beneficência e comunicação, porque com tais sacrifícios Deus se agrada.

verses.original: Πείθεσθε τοῖς ἡγουμένοις ὑμῶν καὶ ὑπείκετε αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀγρυπνοῦσιν ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ὡς λόγον ἀποδώσοντες ἵνα μετὰ χαρᾶς τοῦτο ποιῶσιν καὶ μὴ στενάζοντες ἀλυσιτελὲς γὰρ ὑμῖν τοῦτο
verses.transliteration: Peithesthe tois hēgoumenois hymōn kai hypeikete autoi gar agrypnousin hyper tōn psychōn hymōn hōs logon apodōsontes hina meta charas touto poiōsin kai mē stenazontes alysiteles gar hymin touto
verses.literal: Obey your leaders and submit to them for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account To this end allow them to lead with joy and not with grief for that would be of no advantage to you
verses.literalPt: Obedecei a vossos pastores, e sujeitai-vos a eles; porque velam por vossas almas, como aqueles que hão de dar conta delas; para que o façam com alegria e não gemendo, porque isso não vos seria útil.

verses.original: Προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν πειθόμεθα γὰρ ὅτι καλὴν συνείδησιν ἔχομεν ἐν πᾶσιν καλῶς θέλοντες ἀναστρέφεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Proseuchesthe peri hēmōn peithometha gar hoti kalēn syneidēsin echomen en pasin kalōs thelontes anastrephesthai
verses.literal: Pray for us we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way
verses.literalPt: Orai por nós, porque confiamos que temos boa consciência, como aqueles que em tudo querem portar-se honestamente.

verses.original: περισσοτέρως δὲ παρακαλῶ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι ἵνα τάχιον ἀποκατασταθῶ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: perissoterōs de parakalō touto poiēsai hina tachion apokatastathō hymin
verses.literal: And I especially urge . . . you to pray . . . that I may be restored to you soon
verses.literalPt: E rogo-vos com instância que assim o façais, para que eu mais depressa vos seja restituído.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ἐκ νεκρῶν τὸν ποιμένα τῶν προβάτων τὸν μέγαν ἐν αἵματι διαθήκης αἰωνίου τὸν Κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Theos tēs eirēnēs ho anagagōn ek nekrōn ton poimena tōn probatōn ton megan en haimati diathēkēs aiōniou ton Kyrion hēmōn Iēsoun
verses.literal: Now may the God of peace who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus that great Shepherd of the sheep
verses.literalPt: Ora, o Deus de paz, que pelo sangue da aliança eterna tornou a trazer dos mortos a nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, grande pastor das ovelhas,

verses.original: καταρτίσαι ὑμᾶς ἐν παντὶ ἀγαθῷ εἰς τὸ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιῶν ἐν ἡμῖν τὸ εὐάρεστον ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: katartisai hymas en panti agathō eis to poiēsai to thelēma autou poiōn en hēmin to euareston enōpion autou dia Iēsou Christou hō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: equip you with every good thing to do His will And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight . . . through Jesus Christ to whom be glory forever and ever Amen
verses.literalPt: Vos aperfeiçoe em toda a boa obra, para fazerdes a sua vontade, operando em vós o que perante ele é agradável por Cristo Jesus, ao qual seja glória para todo o sempre. Amém.

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί ἀνέχεσθε τοῦ λόγου τῆς παρακλήσεως καὶ γὰρ διὰ βραχέων ἐπέστειλα ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Parakalō de hymas adelphoi anechesthe tou logou tēs paraklēseōs kai gar dia bracheōn epesteila hymin
verses.literal: I urge you brothers to bear with my word of exhortation for I have only written to you briefly
verses.literalPt: Rogo-vos, porém, irmãos, que suporteis a palavra desta exortação; porque abreviadamente vos escrevi.

verses.original: Γινώσκετε τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν Τιμόθεον ἀπολελυμένον μεθ’ οὗ ἐὰν τάχιον ἔρχηται ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ginōskete ton adelphon hēmōn Timotheon apolelymenon meth’ hou ean tachion erchētai opsomai hymas
verses.literal: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released If he arrives soon I will come with him to see you
verses.literalPt: Sabei que já está solto o irmão Timóteo, com o qual, se ele vier depressa, vos verei.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε πάντας τοὺς ἡγουμένους ὑμῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰταλίας
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe pantas tous hēgoumenous hymōn kai pantas tous hagious Aspazontai hymas hoi apo tēs Italias
verses.literal: Greet all your leaders and all the saints Those from Italy send you greetings . . .
verses.literalPt: Saudai a todos os vossos chefes e a todos os santos. Os da Itália vos saúdam.

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: Grace be with all of you
verses.literalPt: A graça seja com todos vós. Amém.
